summary: Master cloud migration with our training course focused on strategies and best practices. Equip yourself with the knowledge to ensure a smooth transition.
lede: Cloud migration training covers planning and moving on-premises workloads into cloud environments. For technical professionals and IT leaders, it develops skills in assessing readiness and costs, mapping workload dependencies, selecting migration approaches, and planning cutovers; learners also explore application modernization, data migration, and ongoing cost and performance optimization.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for technical professionals and IT leaders who are tasked with planning, executing, or overseeing the transition of on-premises workloads to cloud environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of IT infrastructure, including servers, networking, and databases. Familiarity with basic cloud concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) is recommended. No prior coding or programming experience is required, though basic knowledge of command-line interfaces is helpful for technical exercises.
